reviewer: Codex visual inspection of the exact six PNGs and original source figures
disposition: Accepted as a documented approximation for main-clutch development; historical fit remains unqualified.
findings: The external seven-turn coil, split rear flange, front coupling and rounded shaft shoulders are visible and in the order shown by HB71 and SNL21.

The transverse section exposes two bolt stacks and nominal clamp-to-shaft contact without drilling the shaft. True centre sections miss these off-axis bolts; original drawings project hardware into that view.
Spring end contact lies outside the centre section in places because of inferred clocking. Mechanical seat tests are required separately; the picture alone does not establish contact.
Six front holes are intentionally empty until the mating SH999A collar and actual fastening geometry are constructed.
The dark V-belt and pump context retain the preceding visual style. The new spring does not obscure all of the cardan shaft.
The originals have opposite orientations and independent panel scales. Approximate hidden cast profiles, shaft fillet sizes, collar lugs and axial proportions remain unresolved.
HB SH864B to SNL SH945A size transfer and inside-diameter/installed-length conventions remain explicit assumptions. The source comparison is not metrology.
No claim of complete clutch, spring load capacity, full tank integration or exact historical fit.

Original p033 confirms the callout25 indexing mismatch between the explicit SH849A bolt allocation and the next cleat-bolt row. The refreshed comparison includes this limitation; original survey remains unchanged.
